title: string value that can be support nottable, optional or a json schema

before.description: date-time matcher: matches a value earlier than this; now, now with an offset such as now -1 days, or a date-time such as 2026-10-21T15:00:00Z

after.description: date-time matcher: matches a value later than this; now, now with an offset such as now -1 days, or a date-time such as 2026-10-21T15:00:00Z

equalToDateTime.description: date-time matcher: matches a value at the same instant as this; now, now with an offset such as now -1 days, or a date-time such as 2026-10-21T15:00:00Z

actualFormat.description: date-time matcher: how the actual value is written, a Java DateTimeFormatter pattern or iso, rfc1123, epochSeconds or epochMillis; by default any of those forms

truncateExpected.description: date-time matcher: truncate the expected value, such as startOfDay or first day of month

truncateActual.description: date-time matcher: truncate the actual value, such as startOfDay or first day of month

applyTruncationLast.description: date-time matcher: truncate now after adding its offset instead of before

zone.description: date-time matcher: zone for values without one, for truncation and for day, month and year offsets; default UTC
